views.title: Unlock the number row for iPhone, and more…

views.markdown:
5Row Pro adds a number row to the stock iOS keyboard. A simple thing that makes a real difference, and one Apple keeps choosing to forget.

More than a number row, 5Row also adds a row of the symbols you use most (press Shift or 123), so you type faster. It also supports Latin keyboards and many non-Latin layouts.

## Read before buying

- Tested by me on iOS 15.0.2 (RootHide) and 17.2.1 (Dopamine, rootless). Users have reported it working on 15.4, 16.4–16.7 and 17.0. Rootless and RootHide builds are both available.
- **iPhone only, portrait keyboard only.** Handwriting and third-party keyboards are not supported.

## Features

- Adds a number row (1–0) above the letters
- Adds a symbol row (. , ? @ ! : - / ( )) when you press Shift or 123
- Rename the 123 and ABC keys
- Exclude apps that should keep the stock keyboard

## Only in Pro

- Set every key of the number row and the symbol row to whatever you like, emoji and accented letters included
- Choose which row shows on the normal keyboard, with Shift and on the 123 plane, in any combination
- Adjust the key height to your liking while the keyboard keeps Apple's layout and proportions. A small setting that makes typing noticeably more comfortable, especially for different hand sizes
- Keep five rows on the 123 plane, or drop back to the stock four
- Activate once and you're done, even if you use it offline afterwards

## Activation

Sign in to Havoc in Sileo or Zebra on this device, then buy the tweak. 5Row Pro asks once to activate; tap Activate and respring. Done.

## Support

In 5Row Pro's settings, turn on the diagnostic log, reproduce the issue, then copy or export the log and email it to pitroytechcode@gmail.com together with your iOS version and jailbreak. The log is encrypted; it shows which apps loaded the tweak and how the keyboard was built, never what you typed.

views.title: Availability
views.text: Sold on Havoc. This repo carries the free 5Row.

views.markdown:
- Initial release on Havoc.
- Reworked the core so the fifth row is added to the stock keyboard more accurately and more efficiently
- Steadier activation: activate once and you're done, even if you use the tweak offline afterwards

- Shift and 123 now show the punctuation row you actually use (fixes the doubled number row)
- Rename the ABC and 123 keys, up to five characters each
- Added a reset-to-defaults button
- Always show five rows is now on by default
- Better diagnostic logging, plus a support email
- Various interface and stability fixes
- First public beta, posted on r/jailbreak
